ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a signal flow graph. The input R(s) first passes through gain 1 to reach the first internal node N1; from N1 there is a downward unit-gain branch to the output C(s). The main chain continues as N1 -> N2, gain 1/s; N2 -> N3, gain 6; N3 -> N4, gain 1/s. The feedback/return branches include N2 -> N1, gain -2; N4 -> N3, gain -3; and N4 -> N2, gain -4. Reasoning: According to the method specified in the problem, regard the output C(s) as a downward unit tap from the first internal node N1. Therefore the only forward path is R -> N1 -> C, path gain P1 = 1. The directed loops are: L1 = (N1 -> N2 -> N1) = (1/s)(-2) = -2/s; L2 = (N3 -> N4 -> N3) = (1/s)(-3) = -3/s; L3 = (N2 -> N3 -> N4 -> N2) = 6(1/s)(-4) = -24/s. The only pair of non-touching loops is L1 and L2, whose product is (+6/s^2). So the Mason total determinant Delta = 1 - (L1+L2+L3) + L1L2 = 1 - (-2/s - 3/s - 24/s) + 6/s^2 = 1 + 29/s + 6/s^2 = (s^2 + 29s + 6)/s^2. The forward path R -> N1 -> C touches N1, so L1 is excluded; the loops not touching this path are L2 and L3, and they touch each other, so Delta1 = 1 - (L2+L3) = 1 - (-3/s - 24/s) = 1 + 27/s = (s+27)/s. By Mason's formula, C(s)/R(s) = P1 Delta1 / Delta = [(s+27)/s] / [(s^2+29s+6)/s^2] = s(s+27)/(s^2+29s+6).

Write one linear equation for each node by summing all incoming signal-flow branches, using the displayed gains and signs. Since C(s) is the unity output from the first internal node, set C = x1. 推理：按每个节点的所有输入支路列方程：x1 = R - 2x2；x2 = (1/s)x1 - 4x4；x3 = 6x2 - 3x4；x4 = (1/s)x3。先消去最后两个节点变量。由 x4 = x3/s 得 x3 = sx4。代入 x3 = 6x2 - 3x4，得到 sx4 = 6x2 - 3x4，因此 (s+3)x4 = 6x2，即 x4 = 6x2/(s+3)。代入 x2 = x1/s - 4x4，得到 x2 = x1/s - 24x2/(s+3)，所以 x2(1 + 24/(s+3)) = x1/s，即 x2((s+27)/(s+3)) = x1/s。因此 x2 = x1(s+3)/(s(s+27))。再代入第一节点方程 x1 = R - 2x2，得到 x1 = R - 2x1(s+3)/(s(s+27))。移项得 R = x1[1 + 2(s+3)/(s(s+27))] = x1[(s(s+27)+2s+6)/(s(s+27))] = x1[(s^2+29s+6)/(s(s+27))]。由于 C(s)=x1，所以 C(s)/R(s) = s(s+27)/(s^2+29s+6)。

ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a signal flow graph. The input R(s) first passes through gain 1 to reach the first internal node N1; from N1 there is a downward unit-gain branch to the output C(s). The main chain continues as N1 -> N2, gain 1/s; N2 -> N3, gain 6; N3 -> N4, gain 1/s. The feedback/return branches include N2 -> N1, gain -2; N4 -> N3, gain -3; and N4 -> N2, gain -4. Reasoning: According to the method specified in the problem, regard the output C(s) as a downward unit tap from the first internal node N1. Therefore the only forward path is R -> N1 -> C, path gain P1 = 1. The directed loops are: L1 = (N1 -> N2 -> N1) = (1/s)(-2) = -2/s; L2 = (N3 -> N4 -> N3) = (1/s)(-3) = -3/s; L3 = (N2 -> N3 -> N4 -> N2) = 6(1/s)(-4) = -24/s. The only pair of non-touching loops is L1 and L2, whose product is (+6/s^2). So the Mason total determinant Delta = 1 - (L1+L2+L3) + L1L2 = 1 - (-2/s - 3/s - 24/s) + 6/s^2 = 1 + 29/s + 6/s^2 = (s^2 + 29s + 6)/s^2. The forward path R -> N1 -> C touches N1, so L1 is excluded; the loops not touching this path are L2 and L3, and they touch each other, so Delta1 = 1 - (L2+L3) = 1 - (-3/s - 24/s) = 1 + 27/s = (s+27)/s. By Mason's formula, C(s)/R(s) = P1 Delta1 / Delta = [(s+27)/s] / [(s^2+29s+6)/s^2] = s(s+27)/(s^2+29s+6).
